intro: Describe what you need in plain language, or filter the catalogue. Models, toolkits and non-AI companions are labelled separately with their evidence.
needPlaceholder: e.g. detect people on a camera offline with a tiny model
resultsLegend: — = unknown or not applicable; never inferred. “Target class” is an upstream target, not reproduced compatibility.
emptyFilter: No matching entries. Try fewer filters or inspect untested candidates.
emptyNeed: No entries matched. Try naming the task, sensor or constraint differently.
footer: Evidence before claims. Need matching is deterministic and runs offline. No model inference, analytics or external API calls run in this browser.
